description: Receives authenticated Pebble ring events and delivers their sanitized metadata and transcript to the CodeTerm General Agent.
configHelp: Requires a CodeTerm host with multipart webhook support. In Pebble CoreApp set the webhook URL to your reachable CodeTerm HTTPS origin plus /api/plugins/pebble/webhook, add Authorization: Bearer <secret>, and select Transcription only. Store that secret as pebble_webhook_secret in CodeTerm Settings > Secrets. Do not override Content-Type: CoreApp supplies multipart/form-data with its boundary. HTTP 415 requires a multipart-capable host, not a JSON header. The plugin receives transcription, recordedAt, client, and optional test fields; it does not read secrets, make network requests, or deduplicate unsigned events.
